caption: Averaging improves observed split-half decision stability while leaving the minimizer uncertain. Mean-of-ten halves reduce mean symmetric cross-table regret in all four pools. caption: Feature additions and reverse ablations support distinct within-route comparisons. F0 contains the baseline descriptors; F3 adds composition chemistry, missingness and charge/ionic-geometry descriptors including tau; E1 adds the neutral-atom electronic block. For R-log, pooled RMSE falls from 5.1954 at F0 to 4.9547 at F3 and 4.9048 at F3+E1; mean EF rises from 27.05 to 57.37 and 60.49. The lower panels compare H-soft after removing electronic, geometry or X-statistics blocks with full H-soft, using removal minus full as the sign convention. Removing geometry increases RMSE by 0.1396 and decreases EF by 8.7049. Horizontal bars reuse the corrected 95% paired AB percentile intervals from 5,000 stored resamples; EF uses the equal-fold macro endpoint. The intervals condition on frozen OOF and prior selection, are exploratory, and have no multiplicity correction. Removals include tagged dependencies; X-statistics removal also removes dependent geometry terms, so these are not orthogonal causal effects. No additional fits, bootstrap draws or selection are performed.
